description: Save a durable review about geometry: a semantic feature (give it a name, e.g. 'mounting holes') or a plain note (no name). Re-remembering a named feature REPLACES it (use this to correct the AI). Re-remembering the same entities without a name APPENDS facts. The more you save, the more the system understands the part across sessions.

revision.description: sha256 revision of the artifact, copied from a Geometry inspect result. It is the anchor every record is stored against, and recall compares it to mark records stale.

units.description: Spatial unit of the source file, echoed from inspect.

uri.description: Artifact location: a URI such as file:///parts/curved-sector.step, or a plain filesystem path such as /parts/curved-sector.step. Both address the same records, because a path is normalised to a file: URL before anything is stored against it. A relative path resolves against this server working directory. Records are grouped by it; without a URI the revision alone is the key.

entities.description: Geometry this review refers to, e.g. ['face:26','face:27'] or component-scoped ['component:wheel-axle/face:0']. IDs come from a Geometry find_entities result.

entity_id_scheme.description: ID scheme the entity IDs come from, as reported by the producer, e.g. 'occt-topology-v1' for Geometry. IDs are meaningless across schemes.

name.description: Optional feature name (a semantic, reusable label). Provide it when this is a named group like 'mounting holes' or 'bottom face'; omit for a plain note.

note.description: Prose about the geometry. What does it do, what did we decide, what should we remember?
